headline: International Breweries Pre-Tax Profit Rises 22% to N90.4 Billion
summary: Nigerian beverage company International Breweries reported a 21.9% rise in 9-month pre-tax profit to N90.44 billion, though higher income taxes reduced net profit by 5.7%.
why: Fast-moving consumer goods companies in Africa provide a benchmark for consumer purchasing power amid macroeconomic adjustment.
